Vinegar Syndrome Presents – DEMON WIND (1989) in the Movie Madness Miniplex!

Taking equal inspiration from THE EVIL DEAD and the visual aesthetics of the early 1980s work of Lucio Fulci, DEMON WIND is a supernatural shocker loaded with an abundance of gore and extraordinarily great creature effects. The strange and brutal deaths of Cory’s grandparents have haunted him for years. Determined to discover the truth, he returns to the desolate region where they lived to try and uncover the mystery. Ignoring warnings from the locals that the area is cursed, Cory and his friends soon realize that the legend of the “demon wind” is true. Originally released on VHS with a hologram cover, DEMON WIND has been beautifully restored from its original 35mm camera negative.
